name: A to 1
source:
Main character's father after college went on a journey to record traditions. Protagonist visits one of the described lesser known towns with the book in hand. One day the legend buried in history becomes reality for him, and the journey begins again.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父亲大学毕业后踏上了记录传统的旅程。主角带着这本书参观了所描述的鲜为人知的城镇之一。有一天，埋藏在历史中的传说对他来说成为了现实，旅程再次开始。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
